digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter test suite (Cloud and Data Center reconciliation)
propositions: Cloud and Data Center Jira adapters share backend logic but were hardened by different production paths, creating asymmetric test coverage that leaves both adapters vulnerable to untested operational edges.
Data Center adapter lacks pinned field values, sanitizer boundary assertions, and identity label form coverage despite these being critical for confidence in the shipped feature.

Oversized comment and description convergence behavior in Data Center adapter requires multi-pass testing and documented provenance linking to Jira server configuration, but this test coverage is absent.
A ticket-type mapping dictionary is duplicated across adapters without a build-time guard, allowing the two definitions to diverge undetected and breaking shared code paths.
Five test cases in the suite are vacuous—they pass regardless of correctness—creating false confidence in behaviors that may not actually be validated.
Cloud's whole-project readers have never been tested with pagination beyond one page, whereas this operational edge is known in Data Center and must be verified symmetrically.
